title: GS21 uniform output exposure 0.1 y with a continuous firm-level coupon drawn at birth from [0.1, 0.9] (gs_fixcs 2), one type, price 2.5: the 3a control built as in BGN and KP14 (leverage amplifies equity's exposure; nothing in the exponent but the type's loading)
question: Is a uniform output exposure, amplified by an exogenous continuous coupon, priced linearly through leverage (the 3a control)?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-09). Section 3 asks the three models to be built the same way: a type-level loading b_f multiplies the firm's whole cash flow, and the within-firm state (asset composition in BGN and KP14, leverage in GS21) enters only through the model's own value / cash-flow structure, never in the exponent. PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION: monotone in leverage; priced linearly; no fair gap.
